roads.name: East 1150 Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 10 curves in 2.2 miles.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 910 to 1,085 ft, with 226 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.42 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
